texts.preamble: Initiating Suo Moto Action vs State Of Jk & Ors. on 5 October, 2017 Author: Alok Aradhe Bench: Alok Aradhe
texts.facts: The creation of the post of Commissioner of Food Safety has still not been completed. As per the status report presented on 04.10.2017 on behalf of the State of J&K through the Principal Secretary to the Government, Health & Medical Education Department, it is evident that the proposal submitted to the Finance Department for creation of the post has been cleared by the said department. However, in the said report, it is submitted that the proposal was for the creation of the post of Commissioner of Food Safety along-with supportive staff, but the Finance Department has only cleared the proposal for creation of the post of Commissioner of Food Safety and not of the supportive staff. 2. We fail to understand how the Government is functioning. When the proposal was for the post of Commissioner of Food Safety along-with supportive staff, the entire proposal ought to have been cleared. This is not merely as per the directions given by the Court, but it is the mandate of the Act Initiating Suo Moto Action vs State Of Jk & Ors. on 5 October, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46007244/ 1 that there must be a Commissioner of Food Safety. The Finance Department is directed to clear the proposal within a week. Thereafter, the same be placed before the Cabinet for final approval. We hope that this process would be completed at the earliest and that the process of selecting the persons to fill the post of Commissioner of Food Safety along-with the supportive staff is also completed at an early date and not later than six weeks from today. 3. With regard to 16 Food Safety Officers, we are informed that the Service Selection Board by the letter dated 25.09.2017, has recommended the select list of 16 Food Safety Officers and one Assistant Public Analyst. The same was received by the concerned department on 28.09.2017 and the appointment orders are likely to be issued shortly. The applications have been acknowledged vide communication dated 31.08.2017 and 06.09.2017 respectively. It was further submitted that with regard to achieve the said accreditation, two Food Analysts, one from Srinagar and one from Jammu were deputed to the National Institute of Training for Standardization Bureau of Indian Standards for undergoing the necessary training. 5. On the previous occasion itself, it had been recorded that the kitchen has been shifted from the building where the Forensic Science Laboratory, Srinagar is functioning. The kitchen was being run by the police authorities who have since closed the kitchen, however, the space is yet to be vacated by them. This was recorded on the previous occasion. Further progress in the matter was to be reported. Unfortunately, the said report has been submitted on 04.10.2017, but no progress has been indicated.
